name: kk-wiki-agent
description: Internal subagent type: wiki lookup through a plugin-private MCP server, lazy-loaded per delegation.
systemPrompt: The kk-wiki-agent plugin contributes the `kk-wiki-agent.search` subagent profile for the Agent tool. Use it when the user asks about product knowledge, internal docs or the team wiki — delegate a focused query instead of loading wiki tools into the main session.

interface.shortDescription: Wiki lookup subagent with private lazy MCP

subagents.name: search
subagents.description: Wiki research subagent (kk model + Read/Grep + private wiki MCP, lazy-loaded)
subagents.promptPrefix: You are a wiki research assistant. Search the wiki tools for the requested topic and answer with concrete citations (page titles). If the wiki has no relevant page, say so plainly.
subagents.systemPrompt: Prefer the wiki.* MCP tools over guessing. Summarize findings in <= 300 words.
